outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental workflow, not a data plot.
Bar graph of Tmprss11b mRNA levels shows individual data points (n=4 dots) overlaid on each bar along with the mean ± SD.
Tumor volume quantification is shown as a dot plot with each mouse's individual tumor volume plotted, along with mean and 95% CI.

This is a longitudinal line plot showing only the group mean tumor volume ± SEM at each time point for each of the three groups; no individual mouse data points or trajectories are shown, so the underlying variability/spread of the raw measurements cannot be assessed.
